name: calendar-tsx-root
description: A headless, framework-agnostic calendar library on TanStack Store and Temporal, with React and Solid bindings.
author: Frantss <frantss.bongiovanni@gmail.com>

scripts.test: vp run @calendar-tsx/core#test && vp run @calendar-tsx/react#test && vp run @calendar-tsx/solid#test && vp run @calendar-tsx/themes#test && vp run @calendar-tsx/rrule#test && vp run @calendar-tsx/docs#test
scripts.check:package: vp run @calendar-tsx/core#check:package && vp run @calendar-tsx/react#check:package && vp run @calendar-tsx/solid#check:package && vp run @calendar-tsx/themes#check:package && vp run @calendar-tsx/rrule#check:package
scripts.check: vp lint --type-aware && vp fmt --check && vp run -r check:types
scripts.check:all: vp run -w check && vp run -w check:package
scripts.version:release: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only && vp fmt --write .changeset packages/*/package.json packages/*/CHANGELOG.md pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.prepublish: vp run -w build && vp run -w check:all
scripts.prototype:interactions:types: vp exec tsc -p packages/core/prototypes/interaction-foundation/tsconfig.json && vp exec tsc -p packages/core/prototypes/interaction-foundation/third-party/tsconfig.json && vp exec tsc -p packages/core/prototypes/interaction-foundation/tsconfig.public.json && vp exec tsc -p packages/react/prototypes/interaction-foundation && vp exec tsc -p packages/solid/prototypes/interaction-foundation && vp exec tsc -p packages/react/prototypes/interaction-foundation/tsconfig.public.json && vp exec tsc -p packages/solid/prototypes/interaction-foundation/tsconfig.public.json
